The first time waiting for a rare item in a popular online game. It was in a specific expansion, I think around the second week, and I had learned about an item that I wanted reeeally badly so I said sure it can't be that bad to get! Keep in mind this thing was supposed to spawn on one point on the map(of 6 points in total) every 50-80 hours or so and there were hundreds of people waiting on every server for it!  There was a public spreadsheet of the servers, when the last kill was, and the time that passed since then! So first group I joined we spent about 10-15 hours and nothing so the group disbanded. I was determined so I stayed alone after that, but went crazy and started roleplaying in general chat, for some reason. It was hilarious since another person joined in so I added him and eventually we made a whole group(literally, a crew) in the chat, so we made a group(6 of us!) and continued camping and roleplaying(we sung songs about the spawn trying to summon him, didn't work) for a few more hours. My companion told me he had been camping for 60 hours(this was my 20th hour) without sleeping and was just about to go to sleep but I told him to stay just a while longer, and as it turned out the thing spawned! On another point on the map!!! As soon as we saw it in the chat, and so did 2 more groups of 80 people, we ran to it's spawn hoping they haven't killed it! Sadly only 2 of us got there in time, and my companion was going to log after that, I was so sad for him! He left and zoned out to his own realm, and IT SPAWNED ON HIM!!! I shit you not, I was so happy for him but back then I'm not sure he even felt emotion after 60h of being sleep deprived.. Since then we've become great friends, and he's one of the nicest people I know! Thanks a specific player, you were worth waiting for! TL;DR I made a crew and found a friend, and we camped for endless hours!(well,  thankfully, not really!)
